definitions.explanation: The branch of physics that studies electricity, magnetism, and the interactions between them. A standard subject in university science and engineering curricula.

examples.japanese: {電磁気学|でんじきがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
{電磁気学|でんじきがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{物理学|ぶつりがく}→物理学：09631_butsurigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Electromagnetism is one of the foundations of physics.
